segments.text: You're going to be my new client this month because I'm starting a new series where I
give you 30 days of easy tips that I would do if I was just starting my health journey.
Tip one, start adding electrolytes to your water every single morning.
Electrolytes help you properly retain fluid, keeping you way more hydrated.
So think better, energy levels, immune health, and no more headaches.
